title: Extra Suspension Months for Hospital and Rehabilitation Absences — Personal Services Plan
content:
A resident whose assisted living residency under the Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement shows a hospital or rehabilitation absence is allowed extra months when a Personal Services Plan package is suspended for as long as the package allows.

## Rule

Where the resident's assisted living residency is on leave for a hospital or rehabilitation absence, 2 months are added to the total months a suspension may run; where the residency is active again after a hospital or rehabilitation absence that ended no more than 30 days before the request, 1 month is added; otherwise no month is added for an absence.

The records read are those of the assisted living residency: its status (on leave or active), the reason recorded for its absence (a hospital stay or a rehabilitation facility stay) and the absence's return date. "Ended no more than 30 days before the request" counts calendar days from the return date to the date of the request.

## Ladder

| Assisted living residency status | Recorded absence | Return date | Months added |
|---|---|---|---|
| On leave | Hospital or rehabilitation | — | 2 |
| Active | Hospital or rehabilitation | 0 to 30 days before the request | 1 |
| Active | Hospital or rehabilitation | More than 30 days before the request | 0 |
| On leave or active | Any other reason, or none | — | 0 |
| No assisted living residency | — | — | 0 |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical request on 31 May)

| Residency active again, return date | Days before the request | Months added |
|---|---|---|
| 1 May | 30 | 1 |
| 30 April | 31 | 0 |

*Hypothetical:* a resident whose assisted living residency is on leave for a rehabilitation stay on the day of the request has 2 months added; the same resident, back and active with a return date 12 days earlier, has 1 month added.
